aawt.midnightconfig.title: Axes Are Weapons Too Settings
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.aawt: Turns the axe into a proper weapon with its own enchantments.
aawt.midnightconfig.knockbackSuppression: Share of knockback removed from axe hits. The value 0.4 equals the knockback resistance of a full set of netherite armor.
aawt.midnightconfig.playerHeadNaming.too: Placeholders: %username% for the victim, %killer% for the attacker, %uuid% for the victim's UUID. A translation key in the template is shown in the reader's language. Built-in key: aawt.head_naming.head_of. An empty value keeps the vanilla name.
aawt.midnightconfig.playerHeadLore.toolt: Template of the description line under the head's name. Placeholders: %username% for the victim, %killer% for the attacker, %uuid% for the victim's UUID. A translation key is shown in the reader's language. Built-in keys: aawt.head_description.killed_by, aawt.head_description.chopped_by, aawt.head_description.dynamic (the vanilla "Dynamic" line). An empty value removes the description line and the vanilla line with it.
enchantment.aawt.beheading.desc: A mob or player killed with an axe may drop their head.
enchantment.aawt.cleaving.desc: An axe hit that breaks a shield ignores part of its protection and keeps it disabled longer.
